verdict.rationale: Plaid's API documents real-time balance and up to 24 months of transaction retrieval, with a Node SDK, webhooks for Item changes, and Sandbox endpoints for creating Items programmatically, so an agent could drive the core data operations through code. However, the official MCP server is a Dashboard tool for diagnostics and analytics (debugging Items, Link conversion, usage metrics), not a way to operate link sessions or fetch account data. Link itself is a client-side component the end user interacts with, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: MCP tools for creating link sessions or retrieving balances and transactions, documented server-side link-session creation, scoped or least-privilege agent credentials, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
